name: HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Ultimate (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Ultimate is the top-tier build in the WaveRider V2 line, running 94 magnets total on a 26-point core with 20 core magnets and 6 magnetic rings. This is the version for cubers who want every layer of the WaveRider magnetic system working at once.
features: Maximum magnetic feel: 94 magnets across the cube, the highest configuration in the WaveRider V2 line, for dense magnetic coverage on every turn.
Full-system core: a 20-magnet ball-core paired with 6 magnetic rings, so you feel positioning at the core edges and acceleration through every turn.
Grows with you: fully numerical tuning means you can dial in a specific feel now and change it as your solving evolves, without guessing.
Ready to solve out of the box: pre-lubricated with a soft-gloss exterior that resists factory scratches and hand slippage.
64 tactile combinations: 8 levels of spring compression times 8 levels of center tension, set by numbered dials for repeatable results.
Replicate a known feel: the numerical system lets beginners copy the setups preferred by top cubers instead of tuning blind.
